name: set_text_window_pointer_style

stack.evidence: func_001CDCC8 consumes a window ID and pointer style and stores the style at window descriptor +0x06; func_0010B428 suppresses pointer rendering when that field is zero and passes nonzero values to func_0010A2F0, where styles 1 and 2 select distinct texture-coordinate tables

notes: Observed configured styles are 0, 1, and 2. When a window follows a world target, func_0010B0D0 can replace this field with 0 or 1 according to the target's projected screen position.
